identity.name: Potassium lactate
identity.chemical_class: Lactate salt (potassium salt of lactic acid)

function.mechanism: Modulates pH and water activity and contributes ionic effects that can inhibit microbial growth in many processed food systems, especially meat products.

adi.basis: Latest EFSA OpenEFSA dossier for E326 is ongoing risk assessment (no final output/ADI yet).

efsa.key_finding: EFSA indicates E326 is already authorised but re-evaluation is ongoing; January 19, 2026 update notes a new call for data in 2026 and expected completion in 2027.

adi.basis: ADI NOT LIMITED (JECFA potassium lactate solution record; infant-food caveat stated).

concerns.summary: Infant-use caution appears in both regulatory frameworks reviewed: FDA excludes use in infant foods/formula and JECFA comments that D(-)- or DL-lactic acid forms should not be used in infant foods.

Some food-microbiology literature reports adaptive resistance/cross-protection of Listeria under exposure to organic acid salts including potassium lactate; this is mainly a process-control concern rather than direct human toxicology.

no_concern_confirmed: JECFA record lists ADI as NOT LIMITED for potassium lactate (solution).
FDA affirms potassium lactate as GRAS under GMP in 21 CFR 184.1639 (with infant-food exclusion).
No specific IARC monograph classification entry for potassium lactate was identified in reviewed IARC resources.

populations: high consumers of processed meats (quantitative benchmark unavailable in current EFSA dossier)
adi_exceedance.notes: No current EFSA numerical ADI found in the active E326 re-evaluation dossier; JECFA uses a non-numeric ADI category (NOT LIMITED), so formal exceedance calculation is not available from these sources.

risk_assessment.rationale: Current evidence supports continued controlled use: FDA GRAS and JECFA ADI not limited, with no major carcinogenic listing identified. Residual uncertainty remains because EFSA re-evaluation is ongoing and infant-use caveats exist.
key_factors: FDA GRAS with GMP and defined use conditions
JECFA ADI NOT LIMITED and 1974 evaluation record
No specific IARC classification found for potassium lactate
EFSA re-evaluation for E326 is active and not finalized
